events.title: Wiener publishes Cybernetics
events.summary: Norbert Wiener's 1948 book [Cybernetics] coined the field of feedback, control, and communication — in machines and living systems alike.
events.about: Wiener unified servomechanisms, neuroscience, and computing under one vocabulary of signals, noise, and homeostasis. Terms like [cybernetics] and cyberspace descend from this work; control theory in [robotics], thermostats, and autopilots still uses its framework.

narrative.whyChosen: [Cybernetics] named the study of feedback loops that underpin both biology and engineering.
narrative.whyImportant: It bridged wartime control systems research with postwar computing and AI ambitions.
narrative.problemSolved: Engineers and biologists lacked shared language for self-regulating systems.
